title: Garage Force of Miami A1 house

lines.text: $1,095 for a brand-new garage floor coating? That's crazy.
Most floor coating companies charge twelve to fifteen thousand dollars to coat garage floors, patios, driveways.
Right?
Well… sort of.
It comes down to the size, the prep work, and the materials.
But here's the thing…
There's a fair price.
And then there's pricing so crazy high, I don't know how some of these guys sleep at night.
At Garage Force, here's how we do it.
First, we do amazing work.
No corner cutting.
No cheap materials.
We use premium, state-of-the-art floor coatings, that are 20 times stronger than epoxy, in any color you want.
And because we're a small local team, we don't carry all that overhead.
The big companies with offices, sales teams, and ads everywhere?
Guess who pays for that.
You do.
That's not how we do it.
So we keep it simple: top-quality floor coatings that look great and actually last, without charging you way more than you should pay.
The best work, the best materials, at a fair price.
And most of our projects are completed in one day, backed by a lifetime warranty on material and craftsmanship.
Click "Get Quote" to book a quick phone consultation. We'll give you a fair, honest estimate that fits your budget, with no pressure, and no pushy in-home sales visit.
